raw.description:
Senior Strategist, AdTech

Location: Brazil or Mexico (Remote) — servicing the US market

Languages: English(full professional proficiency); Portuguese and/or Spanish a plus

Department: AdTech

About the Role

Cybba is looking for a senior strategist to own media planning and strategy for Cybba's US clients — working remotely from Brazil or Mexico, operating fully to US standards and IAB best practices. This is a hands-on, end-to-end role: you take a client objective and carry it the full distance, from channel strategy and programmatic and social activation through attribution design, execution oversight, and the measured outcome.

You own the margin on what you build, you turn what works into repeatable managed offerings, and you keep a hard record of which proposals win and which lose, so the next strategy is sharper than the last. You operate as a fully integrated extension of Cybba’s US team — fluent in the US AdTech ecosystem and current on where it is heading, able to present at a senior level to US clients and internal leadership alike.

Responsibilities

Media Strategy & Planning

  • Build end-to-end media plans across programmatic, paid social, and emerging channels for US clients, aligned to US planning standards and IAB best practices.
  • Translate client objectives into channel strategy, budget allocation, flighting, and measurement design.
  • Own attribution planning, including foot traffic and closed-loop retail measurement where it applies (Gretel, Measurement Suite, Audience Intelligence).
  • Stay current on the US media landscape, supply availability, and privacy/regulatory constraints (CCPA/CPRA and the expanding patchwork of US state privacy laws).

Platform & Solution Depth

  • Plan and operate across DSPs: The Trade Desk, DV360,and Amazon Ads.
  • Know the supply side: SSP landscape, inventory quality, and DOOH and CTV supply paths into the US market.
  • Deep command of US AdTech standards and IAB frameworks: ads.txt and sellers.json, VAST, Open Measurement, MRC viewability and brand-safety standards, and the identity and privacy shifts reshaping US programmatic.
  • Peparepaid social strategy across Meta, TikTok, and the platforms that matter in the US market.
  • Use measurement and analytics platforms to set KPIs up front and prove outcomes at the end.
  • Working knowledge of identity and audience solutions (LiveRamp and similar).

Profitability & Productization

  • Own campaign and managed-service margin. Scope, price, and structure work to hit profitability targets, not just spend targets.
  • Turn repeatable strategies into productized managed-service offerings the team can deliver efficiently and at scale.
  • Document playbooks so delivery does not depend on a single person’s memory.

Win/Loss Tracking & Feedback Loop

  • Track every proposal: won, lost, the reason, the competitor where known, and the economics.
  • Run a structured feedback loop that pushes those outcomes back into the next round of strategy, pricing, and packaging.
  • Identify the patterns behind wins and codify them. Discard what consistently loses.

Client & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Present strategies, plans, and results to clients and internal leadership. The standard is senior, confident, and clear — at parity with US-based peers.
  • Partner closely with the US product, data engineering, and commercial teams, with substantialworking-hours overlap with US time zones.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, or a related field.
  • 6+ years in media planning and strategy with real programmatic depth.
  • In-depth knowledge of the US digital advertising ecosystem: IAB standards and best practices, the US programmatic supply chain, and current US privacy, identity, and measurement dynamics.
  • Hands-on DSP experience. You have built and optimized live programmatic campaigns, not just briefed them.
  • English at full professional proficiency, written and spoken — non-negotiable for a US-client-facing role.
  • Strong presentation and storytelling skills. You can hold a room and a screen share.
  • Demonstrated ownership of strategy end to end, including the commercial outcome.
  • Strong collaborator who works well across functions and time zones.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional working proficiency in Portuguese and/or Spanish.
  • Experience servicing US clients or working with US-based teams from a nearshore/remote position.
  • Retail media and attribution background.
  • Experience productizing managed services or solutions, not just running campaigns.
  • Familiarity with agile or scrum delivery and the Atlassian stack (Jira, Confluence).

Attributes & Professional Growth

  • Strong interest in operations best practices and bringing structure and rigor to planning, pricing, and delivery workflows.
  • Strong appetite for continuous learning and platform certifications. Relevant credentials expected, or obtainable within the first 90 days:
  • The Trade Desk Edge Academy
  • Meta Blueprint
  • Google (GA4 and Google Ads)
  • DV360 or equivalent DSP certification
  • IAB certification (e.g., Digital Media Buying and Planning, or Digital Ad Operations)

6-Month Success Criteria

  • A documented, repeatable planning and pricing approach live for US accounts.
  • Managed-service margin at or above target on owned accounts.
  • A live win/loss record with a feedback loop that has measurably improved win rate or proposal quality.
  • At least one productized offering shipped and delivered at scale.

Are you customer-obsessed and ready to take the next step to grow your career? Foundever® is looking for a French Speaking Customer Service Representative to join our team, working on behalf of our Client!

Please note that we are unfortunately not able to offer sponsorship for this role.

What will I be doing?

As a Customer Service Representative with Foundever®, you’ll deliver professional, timely, and accurate support for our client. Using telephone and email, the aim of your job is to effectively use your excellent customer service skills to deliver friendly and knowledgeable product information to our end users. You will advise them on procedures to give the best resolution.

You will work as part of a multilingual team, using your French and English language skills to support customers.

Primary Responsibilities

  • You will play an integral role in delivering a superior customer service experience through various channels.
  • Respond to enquiries by phone and email in both French and English, ensuring care and efficiency and within the given timescales.
  • Develop and maintain a full knowledge of Client products and services.
  • Take responsibility to investigate or escalate to a senior member of staff as required.
  • Ensure that cases and calls are logged in accordance with Client and Foundever® guidelines and procedures.
  • Consult product manuals and knowledge bases, advising customers of appropriate options and solutions.
  • Act as a representative for the company, providing first class support.
  • Provide feedback upon resoling incidents by looking at the root cause of the issue and suggest process/procedure improvements where possible.

What skills and experience will I need to succeed?

You could be a great fit for this role if you have:

  • Excellent communication skills (verbal and written) to a fluent standard of English and French, with an ability to personalise communications.
  • Previous customer service experience in a contact centre is highly advantageous.
  • Impeccable attention to detail and accuracy is needed at every level and aspect of the consumer journey.
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to prioritise tasks.
  • Good computer literacy with working knowledge of Microsoft Office.
  • Minimum typing speed of 20 words-per-minute (WPM) on a computer keyboard.
  • Ability to remain calm in challenging situations, work on your own initiative, and under pressure to achieve deadlines.
  • Ability to work flexibility as part of a wider team, seeing the bigger picture and recognising its impact on the customer experience.
  • Self motivated and proactive, must be prepared to investigate and liaise with internal and external operations to resolve cases.

Who is Foundever®?

Foundever® is a global leader in the customer experience (CX) industry. With 150,000 associates across the globe, we’re the team behind the best experiences for +800 of the world’s leading and digital-first brands. Our innovative CX solutions, technology and expertise are designed to support operational needs for our clients and deliver a seamless experience to customers in the moments that matter.

Why join Foundever®?

At Foundever®, you’ll find our contact centre jobs surprising. We believe in memorable experiences for all of our associates, whether you’re just starting out or bring years of expertise and are looking for a fresh challenge – we’re committed to ensuring you thrive every step of the way to create your best moments.

If you would like to have the opportunity to work with our varied and well-known brands, be part of a brilliant and supportive culture that makes a positive impact in the communities where we operate, and enjoy a balanced work-life pattern with a competitive salary, then we want to hear from YOU!

Plus, for those aspiring to build a career in customer experience, you'll be intrigued to discover that Foundever® is a place where 84% of people grow.

Work from Home requirements

This role is only offered on a Work from Home basis, however electronic equipment is provided by us. To be eligible to work from home, you must meet the below requirements:

  • You must have a wired/Ethernet broadband connection with a minimum of 20Mbps download and 10Mbps upload speeds (4G/5G connections are not supported).
  • You must have a secure, private area to work from, with a desk and chair, and no distractions or background noise. This cannot be in a shared space, nor can any other devices be present during working hours (including smart listening devices in the room, such as mobile phones, or any voice command tech). You must also not use any pen/paper or any writing materials. No other people, such as dependants can be in the same room during working hours.

How to Apply

Customer obsession is at the heart of what we do. If that resonates with you, we’d love to hear from you! Please click the ‘Apply now’ button on this advert and we’ll be in touch…

If your application is shortlisted, you can look forward to experiencing the following journey with us:

  • Intro Call: Meet with our in-house recruitment team, who will share more about the role, our business, and be keen to understand more about you and your experience. This is also a great time to ask us any questions you may have!
  • Online Assessment: Complete our quick and simple online assessment, designed to test your French language skills, problem-solving abilities and how you may approach some real-world customer scenarios.
  • Interview: Attend a competency-based interview with our Hiring Team via video call.

Apply Now! We look forward to reviewing your application

Foundever® is an equal opportunity and Disability Confident employer. We value our diversity and we’re committed to making Foundever® a truly inclusive place to work. We recognize and embrace that people work in different ways and we’ll always adapt as much as possible so you have the best and most comfortable working environment that we can offer.

If you need us to make any adjustments to our recruitment process, speak to our recruitment team who will be happy to support you. You can reach us at Recruitment.Edinburgh@foundever.com. Please note this email address may not be used to submit applications, and applications will only be considered if they are submitted via the 'Apply now' button on this advert. Any applications sent to this email address will not be considered.

The personal data you provide in your application, and as part of the recruitment process, will only be held and processed for the purpose of the selection process of Foundever® and in connection with any subsequent employment or placement, unless otherwise indicated. Your data will be retained only for as long as it permitted by UK legislation and then destroyed.

Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

About the Role:

The People Operations Coordinator - Global is responsible for delivering a seamless and high-quality employee experience across the full employee lifecycle. This role serves as a key operational partner, ensuring timely support for employee inquiries, accurate data management across systems, and smooth coordination of onboarding and offboarding processes. With a strong focus on detail, organization, and service, the Coordinator helps maintain compliance, operational efficiency, and a welcoming experience for employees.

What You’ll Do:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for all People Operations inquiries via Jira ticketing, email, and other sources ensuring adherence to service level agreements.

  • Provide tier 1 People Team support such as answering employee questions, people team systems user support, complaint/employee relations intake, verifications of employment, etc.

  • Properly escalate tier 2 People Team support - such as complex issues requiring interpretation and items needing local expertise - to appropriate People Operations team members or engage cross-functional partners as needed.

  • Responsible for People Operations onboarding tasks including but not limited to: processing onboards in HCM ensuring data accuracy, auditing new hire data against applicant tracking system, communication with new hires ensuring all onboarding tasks are completed in a timely manner, and scheduling new hire orientation sessions.

  • Maintain integrity of company HCM and third-party systems – such as local payroll providers and global mobility tools – through accurate and timely data processing.

  • Create new job requisitions (and positions when applicable) in HCM coordinating with cross-functional partners (People Business Partners, Finance, Talent Acquisition, hiring managers) as needed.

  • Responsible for People Operations offboarding tasks including but not limited to: processing terminations in HCM and third-party systems, coordinating offboard with IT and other departments as needed in accordance with service level agreements, and communication with departing and former employees.

  • Ensure protection and security of all confidential information through proper controls and discretion.

  • Assist with compliance reporting and audits such as benefit reporting, government filings, and ad hoc reporting requests.

  • Maintain employee files ensuring accuracy, organization, and compliance.

  • Support for People team initiatives as needed such as: Annual Compensation Review, performance cycles, handbook and policy launches, annual trainings, etc.

Who You Are:

  • 1-3+ years of HR administrative support experience

  • 1+ years Workday HR experience

  • 1+ years with a ticketing service tool (Jira preferred)

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to understand and communicate HR-related information clearly

  • International experience/exposure a plus but not required; preferably HR experience supporting North America and EMEA

  • Familiarity with Excel/Google Sheets (experience with filters, vLookup, formulas, etc. is a plus)

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail with ability to work independently and in a fast-paced environment

  • A strong problem-solver with a proactive approach to challenges, able to work independently.

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Full Time Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD

“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

Full-time employees qualify for our comprehensive benefits package, including:

  • Health, dental and vision insurance

  • 401K

  • Supplies and other perks

Full time

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

Great benefits for great people

We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.

Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments.

raw.description:
About Onehouse

Onehouse is a mission-driven company dedicated to freeing data from data platform lock-in. We deliver the industry’s most interoperable data lakehouse through a cloud-native managed service built on Apache Hudi. Onehouse enables organizations to ingest data at scale with minute-level freshness, centrally store it, and make available to any downstream query engine and use case (from traditional analytics to real-time AI / ML).
We are a team of self-driven, inspired, and seasoned builders that have created large-scale data systems and globally distributed platforms that sit at the heart of some of the largest enterprises out there including Uber, Snowflake, AWS, Linkedin, Confluent and many more. Riding off a fresh $35M Series B backed by Craft, Greylock and Addition Ventures, we're now at $68M total funding and looking for rising talent to grow with us and become future leaders of the team. Come help us build the world's best fully managed and self-optimizing data lake platform!
Onehouse is delivering the next generation of cloud data pipelining by building a fully managed cloud data lakehouse platform. As we execute our product-led growth (PLG) strategy and introduce cutting-edge initiatives like quanton.dev, our goal is to empower organizations to build open, fast, and scalable data architectures without vendor lock-in.
We are seeking a Senior Developer Advocate to become the primary public technical advocate of Onehouse. This is a high-visibility, mission-critical role designed for an active, highly technical member of the data and engineering ecosystem. You will act as a trusted product evangelist, guiding developers, architects, and AI practitioners on how to design next-generation data lakehouse architectures. By translating complex infrastructure capabilities into engaging narratives, you will play an instrumental role in driving the awareness, adoption, and scaling of the Onehouse platform.

A Typical Day

    Technical Storytelling & Content Creation

  • Author Authoritative Content: Write high-quality, deeply technical blog posts, tutorials, architectural blueprints, and deep-dives for onehouse.ai and quanton.dev.
  • Build Social Influence: Maintain a highly active, influential presence across developer-focused social platforms (specifically LinkedIn and X) to drive industry-wide conversations.
  • Deliver Compelling Presentations: Represent Onehouse on the public stage by delivering technical talks, running interactive workshops, hosting webinars, and participating in podcasts or developer panels.

    • Hands-on Technical Enablement

  • Develop Production-Grade Demos: Build, maintain, and open-source complete reference implementations, demo applications, and integration templates on GitHub.
  • Showcase Ecosystem Integrations: Architect and showcase seamless integrations connecting Onehouse with modern data infrastructure tools including Apache Spark, Apache Hudi, Apache Iceberg, Trino, Apache Flink, Apache Kafka, Apache Airflow, dbt, Ray, pyTorch, Apache Polaris.

    • Community Engagement & Feedback Loops

  • Unite the Ecosystem: Serve as a core advocate and technical resource across open-source communities, including the Apache Software Foundation and modern Lakehouse groups.
  • Drive the Product Feedback Loop: Partner directly with Product Management and Engineering. Gather unfiltered feedback from developers and customers to validate new capabilities, shape product messaging, and directly influence our roadmap.
  • Collaborate Internationally: Work alongside Marketing to coordinate major product launches, lead technical campaigns, and manage analyst briefings with technical authority.

What You Bring to the Table:

    Required Experience & Technical Skills

  • 5+ Years of Developer-Facing Experience: Proven background in roles such as Developer Relations, Developer Advocacy, Solutions Engineering, Technical Product Management, or Software Engineering.
  • Deep Data/Lakehouse Domain Expertise: Strong conceptual and practical understanding of modern data lakehouse architectures, open table formats, metadata management, data governance and cloud-native data management.
  • Hands-on Stack Proficiency: Practical experience building, operating, and troubleshooting production pipelines utilizing data technologies such as Apache Spark, Apache Hudi, Apache Iceberg, Trino/Presto, Apache Flink, or Apache Kafka.
  • Cloud Infrastructure Background: Exposure to deploying data solutions on cloud environments, including AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks, or Snowflake.
  • Programming Skills: Strong coding fluency in at least one modern language, such as Python, Java, Scala, or Go.
  • Demonstrated Communication Portfolio: An active public portfolio of written technical content (blogs, guides, docs) and experience speaking in public forums, conferences, or webinars.

    • Preferred Qualifications & Assets

  • Established Digital Presence: An active, highly engaged public following within the data engineering or AI developer community (e.g., active on LinkedIn, X, personal newsletters, or podcasts).
  • AI Data Infrastructure Experience: Familiarity with vector databases, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, or building data platforms that fuel AI/ML workloads.
  • Ecosystem Connections: Existing professional relationships within the open-source communities surrounding Spark, Hudi, Iceberg, Trino, or Flink.
  • Developer Tooling Background: Experience building developer-focused libraries, custom SDKs, APIs, or CLI tools.
How We'll Take Care of You
-Competitive Compensation; the estimated base salary range for this role is $180,000 - $220,000
-Equity Compensation; our success is your success with eligible participation in our company equity plan

Job Overview

Perform monitoring and site management work to ensure that sites are conducting the study(ies) and reporting study data as required by the study protocol, applicable regulations and guidelines, and sponsor requirements.

Essential Functions

  • Perform site monitoring visits (selection, initiation, monitoring and close-out visits) in accordance with contracted scope of work and Good Clinical Practice.
    • Work with sites to adapt, drive, and track subject recruitment plan in line with project needs to enhance predictability.
    • Administer protocol and related study training to assigned sites and establish regular lines of communication with sites to manage ongoing project expectations and issues.
    • Evaluate the quality and integrity of study site practices related to the proper conduct of the protocol and adherence to applicable regulations. Escalate quality issues as appropriate.
    • Manage the progress of assigned studies by tracking regulatory submissions and approvals, recruitment and enrollment, case report form (CRF) completion and submission, and data query generation and resolution. May support start-up phase.
    • Ensure copies/originals (as required) site documents are available for filing in the Trial Master File (TMF) and verify that the Investigator's Site File (ISF) is maintained in accordance with GCP and local regulatory requirements.
    • Create and maintain appropriate documentation regarding site management, monitoring visit findings and action plans by submitting regular visit reports, generating follow-up letters and other required study documentation.
    • Collaborate and liaise with study team members for project execution support as appropriate.
    • If applicable, may be accountable for supporting development of project subject recruitment plan on a per site basis.
    • If applicable, may be accountable for site financial management according to executed clinical trial agreement and retrieve invoices according to local requirement.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree Degree in scientific discipline or health care preferred.

• Oncology studies preferred.

  • Requires at least 4 years of year of on-site monitoring experience. Req
    • Equivalent combination of education, training and experience may be accepted in lieu of degree.
    • Good knowledge of, and skill in applying, applicable clinical research regulatory requirements.
    • i.e., Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and International Conference on Harmonization (ICH) guidelines.
    • Good therapeutic and protocol knowledge as provided in company training.
    • Computer skills including proficiency in use of Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint and use of a laptop computer and iPhone and iPad (where applicable).
    • Written and verbal communication skills including good command of English language.
    • Organizational and problem-solving skills.
    • Effective time and financial management skills.
    • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with coworkers, managers, and clients.

Our client, a leading Software, Information and Communication Technologies company, operates internationally (Athens, Brussels, Luxembourg, Copenhagen, Stockholm, London, Nicosia, Hong-Kong, Valetta, etc). Our client is a renowned supplier of IT services to government institutions, multinational corporations, public administrations and multinational companies, research and academic institutes.

Role Overview

Our client currently has a vacancy for a Scrum Master to offer his/her services as an expert remotely within the EU. In the context of the first assignment, the successful candidate will be integrated in the team of the company that will closely cooperate with a major client’s IT team on site.

Job Type: B2B Contract

Workplace: Remote

Requirements

  • University Degree and at least 8 years of IT professional experience;
  • Minimum of 3 of dedicated experience working as a Scrum Master at SM2 level or above;
  • Led at least 2 production teams through full sprint cycles (planning, review, retrospective, and refinement);
  • Implemented data-driven continuous improvement initiatives, such as increasing team velocity or reducing lead time;
  • Experience coordinating cross-team work via Scrum-of-Scrums or PI Planning events;
  • Deep knowledge of the Scrum Guide and Agile Manifesto principles and values;
  • Good knowledge of facilitation techniques (e.g., Fist of Five, participatory decision-making, Liberating Structures);
  • Good knowledge of systems-thinking and process tailoring to fit complex or evolving environments;
  • Good knowledge of team motivation and stakeholder engagement techniques (e.g., information radiators, team empowerment models);
  • Good knowledge of Agile metrics (velocity, cycle time, burn-up/down charts, cumulative flow diagrams) and the ability to build and interpret dashboards to support team performance and forecasting;
  • Tool proficiency in Azure DevOps (preferred) or Jira, particularly in backlog management, dashboards, and workflow configuration;
  • Possession of Scrum Master certifications: PSM II (or higher) and SAFe 5/6 Agilist;
  • Experience with one or more scaled Agile frameworks (SAFe, Nexus, LeSS, etc.) is considered as an asset;
  • Knowledge of integrating SAFe and Kanban approaches to optimize flow and delivery predictability is considered as an asset;
  • Excellent command of the English language.

Responsibilities

  • Organize and facilitate agile activities and ceremonies including daily stand-up meetings, sprint reviews, retrospectives, sprint and release planning, and product backlog refinement sessions;
  • Ensure that all meetings are positive, productive, stay on topic, and are kept within the timebox;
  • Collaborate closely with the product owner to manage the backlog;
  • Coach team and Product Owner on empiricism, value‑based backlog slicing, and incremental delivery;
  • Track and radiate flow metrics (velocity, sprint burndown, iteration burn rate) and guide the team in data‑driven improvement;
  • Champion and facilitate adoption of agile standards, tools, and best practices;
  • Proactively identify and resolve impediments to team progress;
  • Promote empowered, self‑organising teams, shared vision, psychological safety, collaborative decisions (e.g., Fist‑of‑Five);
  • Uphold Definition of Done, quality gates, and compliance with organisational standards;
  • Communicate with other SCRUM masters and product owners across the organization to ensure transparency into delivery progress, challenges, and risks;
  • Utilize team feedback and metrics (e.g., quality, delivery, cadence, etc.) to identify areas of opportunity and work with team to continuously improve;
  • Support the team in using agile planning and development tools (e.g. Azure DevOps, Confluence);
  • Experiment with new practices and frameworks to improve team outcomes;
  • Actively participate in learning opportunities such as communities of practice or conferences to improve skills and better support the team;
  • Contribute to the advancement and improvement of agile practices within the organization.

Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Sales Development Manager.

About the job

This position is needed to lead a hybrid outbound SDR team driving net-new customer acquisition across both the NAMER and LATAM markets. The Sales Development team is a critical pillar of our go-to-market strategy, focused on securing new logos and building high-quality pipeline across high-growth prospects. In this role, you will guide your team to activate strategic ICPs by mapping Twilio’s platform value to high-priority, regional, and vertical-specific customer needs. As the frontline face of our brand, our SDRs must adapt quickly and execute with high precision to win market share across diverse territories.

The ideal candidate is a highly collaborative, data-driven leader with a proven track record in pipeline generation and a deep appreciation for regional market dynamics. You have experience scaling outbound motions across different territories, navigating diverse account lists, and a genuine passion for coaching and investing in your team's long-term career growth.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Lead, coach, and develop a hybrid team of 8+ reps through regular 1:1 mentoring, tactical skill alignment, and localized training to elevate pipeline performance - initially focusing on supporting 4 LATAM reps.
  • Own regional team performance metrics (activity, conversion rates, and pipeline contribution) across both NAMER and LATAM, utilizing data analysis to continuously optimize outreach strategies and business outcomes.
  • Empower reps to master all SDR skillsets, including prospecting, refining account targeting, tailoring messaging for different regional buyer personas, and applying use cases effectively.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with regional Sales and GTM leadership to establish tight feedback loops, streamline workflows, and build a consistent, high-quality pipeline generation machine.
  • Drive optimized adoption of the SDR tech stack (SFDC, Outreach, ZoomInfo, LI Sales Nav, Gong) to build out repeatable, efficient workflows.
  • Hire, onboard, and scale future talent while proactively managing performance gaps and cultivating a highly motivated, high-accountability team culture.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • 2+ years of Sales/SDR leadership in high-growth tech companies, with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding pipegen targets.
  • Demonstrated success in high-growth customer acquisition, with experience executing or coaching teams through product-led growth (PLG) or hybrid inbound-to-outbound motions.
  • Deep expertise in the LATAM market, including localized selling strategies, cultural nuances, and regional business best practices.
  • Skilled at championing and testing AI utilities within SDR workflows to optimize prospecting, sequencing, and research.
  • Expertise in steering signal-led, high-quality outbound strategies that blend tailored messaging with structured activity KPIs to capture target accounts.
  • Strong understanding of the cloud communications/SaaS industry and the ability to leverage data to optimize qualification and messaging strategies.
  • Proficiency with SDR tech stacks (SFDC, Outreach, ZoomInfo, LI Sales Nav, Gong) and a track record of driving tool adoption.
  • Excellent executive presence with a demonstrated ability to analyze data, coach reps 1:1, and influence stakeholders from ICs to the C-suite.
  • Fluency in Spanish or Portuguese is required (Spanish language preference).

Desired:

  • Experience supporting and/or selling SaaS products (CDP or CPaaS preferred).
  • Strong analytical skills with a focus on pipeline forecasting and rep performance diagnosis.
  • Experience driving multi-threaded engagements across IT, Marketing, Data, and Engineering personas.

Location

This role will be remote, but is not eligible to be hired in CT, NJ, NY, WA, PA or the surrounding areas of San Francisco, CA, Oakland, CA, or San Jose, CA

Travel

raw.description:
At AMA, our brand is important to us and we set the bar for supporting our members. Providing a first-class member experience is the hallmark of working for AMA. We only hire the best and provide a competitive wage with flexible hours and the possibility for future growth and development for our Member Service Representatives. The ideal candidates will have strong customer service & communication skills to provide excellent over-the-phone member experience and will possess an outgoing personality with a positive attitude in conjunction with the ability to be a team player. The ability to have a flexible work schedule is a must, including evening and weekend availability.

How many times have people said to you, “You’re such a good listener”? Or “I knew I could count on you”? You’re the person your friends and family turn to when there’s a crisis because they know that you’ll calmly guide them through the storm. When our members are in difficult and stressful roadside situations, they want to know that they’re in good hands – they want to speak to someone who knows exactly how to get them the help they need, when they need it. It’s exactly these qualities that we’re looking for in a Member Services Representative for our 24/7 Roadside Assistance team.

Days and Hours of Work: Hours of operation for this role are between 8:00 AM - 7:00 PM, and shifts will be scheduled anytime within these hours, 7 days a week. Our shifts are between 3 and 8 hours. Please note that our peak times are evenings and weekends; availability during these times is a requirement of the role. The total number of hours of work will vary and are dependent on business needs. There are no guaranteed hours/shifts; however, once you provide us with your availability, we will do our best to meet that. We request a minimum of 16 hours per week with an open availability that allows this to be met each week. Plus, for your convenience, you’ll get your schedule at least 2 weeks ahead of time, and the option to pick up shifts from your coworkers.

Setting: This position allows you to work from home. Given the high volume and fast pace of the role, your at-home workspace needs to be a dedicated one that is free of any distractions. You will also have access to information that must be kept confidential, so a private space is necessary to ensure the safety and security of all our members.

Training: Training is paid, full-time, can be done remotely, and provided through our in-house online training system combined with facilitator lead training. Classes are from 8:30 am to 4:30 pm, Monday to Friday. Attendance for all dates are required to be eligible for the position. Training is scheduled to start on Monday, August 31, 2026.

Position Requirements:

  • Open availability that allows a minimum of 16 hours per week.

  • Available for at least one evening shift per week.

  • Available for one Saturday or Sunday shift per week (or available for both Saturday and Sunday one week, then off the next weekend).

  • Available to attend all training classes, Monday to Friday, 8:30 am - 4:30 pm.

  • Available for onsite equipment pickup.

  • Private and secure dedicated home office space with stable internet and free of any distractions.

  • A Smartphone device (Apple or Android) for two-factor authentication and stable, high speed internet.

  • Able to pass a Canadian Criminal Record Check.

WHAT MOVES YOU

  • You’re the ultimate “people whisperer” – you can diffuse even the most stressful situations with your warmth and friendliness.

  • You understand that part of being a strong communicator means being a great listener and asking the right questions.

  • When it comes to providing a superior customer experience, you’re all about exceeding expectations. Not only do you excel at meeting peoples’ needs, you’re able to anticipate them.

  • You love the idea of being able to help people and make a difference in their day.

  • You can multi-task like nobody’s business without missing a beat or a single detail.

  • You enjoy being part of a team and working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

  • You love the idea of being on the phone all day—it's your teenage dream come true! (Ditto for getting to wear sweatpants to work every day).

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Report to the Supervisor, Member Rescue.

  • Act as one of the first points of contact for our members when they call for roadside assistance.

  • Respond to high volume inbound calls for roadside assistance.

  • Record member information thoroughly and correctly.

  • Accurately identify call locations and assign calls accordingly.

  • Use your strong geographical skills to process road service requests accurately and efficiently.

  • Know exactly what kind of support is required for priority calls.

  • Stay on top of our AMA products and services, as well as Roadside Assistance services and systems.

  • Learn and understand AMA's membership offerings to educate and inform members of their coverage and costs.

  • Work a variety of shifts (we need our MSR’s mostly in the evenings and weekends especially during the winter time) as we're open 24/7 and be able to sit for extended periods of time.

WHAT YOU’VE DONE

  • You have a high school diploma.

  • You have previous customer service experience, preferably in a call centre environment.

  • Your ability to communicate clearly and with a smile in your voice is equally matched by your excellent telephone etiquette and professionalism.

  • You know your way around a computer and you’re comfortable learning new applications and systems.

  • Bonus points if you have previous work experience using mapping software!

  • You will be able to pass a Canadian Criminal Record Check.

  • You are available to work a variety of shifts as we are open extended hours and are able to sit for extended periods of time.

raw.description:
Our client, a leading Software, Information and Communication Technologies company, operates internationally (Athens, Brussels, Luxembourg, Copenhagen, Stockholm, London, Nicosia, Hong-Kong, Valetta, etc). Our client is a renowned supplier of IT services to government institutions, multinational corporations, public administrations and multinational companies, research and academic institutes.

Role Overview

Our client currently has a vacancy for a Scrum Master to offer his/her services as an expert remotely within the EU. In the context of the first assignment, the successful candidate will be integrated in the team of the company that will closely cooperate with a major client’s IT team on site.

Job Type: B2B Contract

Workplace: Remote

Requirements

  • University Degree and at least 8 years of IT professional experience;
  • Minimum of 3 of dedicated experience working as a Scrum Master at SM2 level or above;
  • Led at least 2 production teams through full sprint cycles (planning, review, retrospective, and refinement);
  • Implemented data-driven continuous improvement initiatives, such as increasing team velocity or reducing lead time;
  • Experience coordinating cross-team work via Scrum-of-Scrums or PI Planning events;
  • Deep knowledge of the Scrum Guide and Agile Manifesto principles and values;
  • Good knowledge of facilitation techniques (e.g., Fist of Five, participatory decision-making, Liberating Structures);
  • Good knowledge of systems-thinking and process tailoring to fit complex or evolving environments;
  • Good knowledge of team motivation and stakeholder engagement techniques (e.g., information radiators, team empowerment models);
  • Good knowledge of Agile metrics (velocity, cycle time, burn-up/down charts, cumulative flow diagrams) and the ability to build and interpret dashboards to support team performance and forecasting;
  • Tool proficiency in Azure DevOps (preferred) or Jira, particularly in backlog management, dashboards, and workflow configuration;
  • Possession of Scrum Master certifications: PSM II (or higher) and SAFe 5/6 Agilist;
  • Experience with one or more scaled Agile frameworks (SAFe, Nexus, LeSS, etc.) is considered as an asset;
  • Knowledge of integrating SAFe and Kanban approaches to optimize flow and delivery predictability is considered as an asset;
  • Excellent command of the English language.

Responsibilities

  • Organize and facilitate agile activities and ceremonies including daily stand-up meetings, sprint reviews, retrospectives, sprint and release planning, and product backlog refinement sessions;
  • Ensure that all meetings are positive, productive, stay on topic, and are kept within the timebox;
  • Collaborate closely with the product owner to manage the backlog;
  • Coach team and Product Owner on empiricism, value‑based backlog slicing, and incremental delivery;
  • Track and radiate flow metrics (velocity, sprint burndown, iteration burn rate) and guide the team in data‑driven improvement;
  • Champion and facilitate adoption of agile standards, tools, and best practices;
  • Proactively identify and resolve impediments to team progress;
  • Promote empowered, self‑organising teams, shared vision, psychological safety, collaborative decisions (e.g., Fist‑of‑Five);
  • Uphold Definition of Done, quality gates, and compliance with organisational standards;
  • Communicate with other SCRUM masters and product owners across the organization to ensure transparency into delivery progress, challenges, and risks;
  • Utilize team feedback and metrics (e.g., quality, delivery, cadence, etc.) to identify areas of opportunity and work with team to continuously improve;
  • Support the team in using agile planning and development tools (e.g. Azure DevOps, Confluence);
  • Experiment with new practices and frameworks to improve team outcomes;
  • Actively participate in learning opportunities such as communities of practice or conferences to improve skills and better support the team;
  • Contribute to the advancement and improvement of agile practices within the organization.

Job Title: In-Home Physician Per Diem - Grand Island

Job Location: Work at Home, Nebraska, United States

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Part time

Job Seniority Level:

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Per Diem Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD

“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

Per diem employees qualify for:

  • Hourly base rate, plus additional incentive structure (i.e., per visit completed, other incentives may apply)

  • Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

  • Supplies and other perks

Required & Preferred Qualifications (MDs and DOs)

  • Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

  • Multi-state licenses (preferred)

Anticipated Weekly Hours

12

Time Type

Part time

Pay Range

The typical pay range for this role is:

$105.00 - $105.00

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

Great benefits for great people

We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.

This part‑time position is eligible for a range of benefits and programs that support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues. Depending on hours worked and eligibility, the benefits for this position include dental, vision, wellness resources, employee discounts, access to certain voluntary benefits, and other programs.

Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments.

We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on: 12/31/2026

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state and local laws.

raw.title: Trending News Reporter
raw.excerpt: Newsquest is looking for a top-class trending news reporter to help lead its online coverage across the UK.
raw.description:
Newsquest is looking for a top-class trending news reporter to help lead its online coverage across the UK.
Every day our online news brands reach millions of people right across the UK, and you’ll be joining a team of driven, innovative journalists taking our search content to the next level as Newsquest invests in the future of its industry-leading digital coverage.
This role presents an exciting opportunity for a digital and multimedia-savvy journalist with a knowledge of SEO trends and practices to spot the latest (and next!) trending news stories, features and lifestyle content.
The key for this role is tapping into these topics and making them not only relevant but insightful for local audiences, as well as keeping on top of what is resonating in your area.

You’ll be delivering the sort of fast, agile and dynamic coverage optimised for SEO that our readers expect and deserve in 2026 – often before they know they want to read it.
You’ll be passionate about digital storytelling, with a desire to come up with new and innovative ways of telling those stories using a vast array of different skills, tools and platforms.
A big part of the job will also be immersing yourself in social media through various monitoring tools to help you tell your stories and spot the next big thing, whether that be hard news, showbiz and TV, celebrity, news features, explainers and ‘news you can use’.
We want to give our readers the content they want to read, when they want to read it.

Your job will be to anticipate this and use your sparkling writing skills to ensure our coverage is the best, and where local audiences choose to come first.

Key Responsibilities

  • Using your SEO skills to reach the largest possible audience
  • Using search tools to research and understand the topics people are searching for
  • Identifying and exploring topics in which local brands can legitimately become an authority
  • Producing high-quality, accurate digital news stories, live blogs and features to deadlines as agreed by editors
  • Respond quickly to breaking news events and support newsrooms with accurate and valuable content
  • Work with the Head of Central Digital Content to understand what to research and write next
  • Building communities online and in real life to share stories with once published, and become engaged with readers about those stories
  • Thinking creatively to come up with new original story ideas and ways to deliver them to our audience that suit our digital platforms
  • Spotting and developing national and regional content that could resonate in your patch and making it relevant and interesting to our readers
  • Helping devise and manage a carefully-plotted SEO forward plan calendar to ensure we don’t miss a beat
  • Ensuring every piece of content is thoroughly researched and balanced before publication
  • With guidance from editors, using analytics to identify what our readers like and what they want next from our coverage
  • Joining forces with Newsquest’s central team and your counterparts across the UK to share ideas, best practice, success stories and skills
  • Communicating with newsrooms around the country to ensure your coverage chimes with the local market

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • An understanding of search engine optimisation (SEO) and skills in producing content which works in search
  • Knowing what readers want to read, using both your keen news sense and data insights
  • Passion for telling stories which will grow new diverse audiences
  • Exceptional attention to detail
  • The ability to write – and think – quickly under pressure
  • A keen news sense
  • Bags of ideas for how stories can be presented in the best possible way for our audiences
  • An understanding of what audiences want, and when
  • Excellent social media skills and the ability to spot stories and trending topics
  • NCTJ qualification (including 100wpm shorthand)
  • Excellent knowledge of relevant media law
  • An adaptable style to produce everything from live blogs and listicles to long-reads and features
  • Great people skills and the ability to get on with a wide range of people in the community
  • A high level of organisation and the ability to manage your own diary out on patch
  • Collaborative skills to pool ideas with the wider digital reporting team and take on board suggestions

Benefits

  • 25 days holiday + bank holidays + your birthday off
  • Holiday buy scheme for extra flexibility
  • Structured career progression & ongoing training
  • Pension plan
  • Employee Helpline counselling and advice
  • Perks & discounts including:
    • Gym membership
    • Cycle to Work scheme
    • Eye care
    • Retail discounts
  • Team building days & annual volunteer charity day

The Recruiter is responsible for Service Excellence throughout the recruitment cycle. They act as a brand ambassador for the client, focused on delivering exceptional talent while providing proactive and timely communication on the status of the search. They serve as subject matter expert in talent acquisition and provide consultative direction and industry expertise to hiring leader.

Responsibilities:

  • Finding Candidates: - Lead a detailed job scope meeting with the hiring leader to determine position specifications, providing relevant market data and recommendations on possible approaches to the search or candidate requirements.
  • Review of candidates who have applied via the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
  • Evaluate candidate qualifications against position requirements and determine who to move forward in the recruitment process.
  • Develop and manage recruitment marketing plans or sourcing plans to determine the most appropriate candidate sources that align to the search requirements.
  • Source candidates via resume databases, search engine and networking sites using Boolean search language.
  • Solicit and pursue referrals from business networks and/or internal referrals.
  • Utilize Cielo’s proprietary software for mobile and email campaigning to talent communities.
  • Engaging Candidates: - Use an appropriate mix of media to connect with talent communities (phone, email, social media, etc.).
  • Articulate value proposition to candidates who are interested in the job opportunity.
  • Prepare candidates for interviews, coaching them on logistical information, interview schedule, appropriate attire and overall expectations.
  • Ensure candidates are provided with timely updates concerning the status of their applications and interviews.
  • Assessing Candidates: - Draft and utilize phone interview templates appropriate to the job description.
  • Use independent judgement to compare candidate phone interview notes and skills assessments with position requirements to determine if the candidate is a match for the role or a potential match for other open positions.
  • Issue skills testing as needed and evaluate results (if process dictates).
  • Review background and reference information (if process dictates).
  • Influencing the Hire: - Keep candidates engaged throughout process, ensuring consistent communication on the status of the search.
  • Partner with hiring leader to determine offer details, using market data and compensation guidelines to support recommendations.
  • Articulate a job offer to candidate and drive for candidate acceptance, anticipating and negotiating counter-offers as appropriate.
  • Service Excellence: - Strict adherence to all regulations (OFCCP and all other compliance standards set forth).
  • Work to deliver a strong candidate slate, continuously building talent pipelines to ensure there are multiple qualified candidates in play at all times.
  • Provide accurate and regular reporting of recruiting activities to the hiring leader and Cielo leadership to depict both metrics and efforts.
  • Identify perceived difficulties with searches and research and recommend solutions to both internal and external stakeholders.
  • Proactively and regularly communicate the status of each search to the hiring leader, providing a consultative approach with recommendations on how to move forward.

Education:

  • High school diploma required. Bachelor’s degree in business, management, human resources or related field is strongly preferred.

Experience:

  • Minimum of two or more years’ recruiting experience with demonstrated successes in a corporate, RPO or agency setting. Experience using recruitment technologies such as Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and social media tools.

Functional/Technical Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required:

  • Proficient in Boolean search techniques for sourcing.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Knowledge of common Human Resources principles, practices and metrics related to talent acquisition.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Are you ready to accelerate your career?

Join Cielo as a Recruiter! A career at Cielo will give you the opportunity to work with the industry’s smartest people and to take ownership of your success!

Cielo is a brand that reflects our big idea – that talent is rising – and with it our opportunity to rise above. We create careers for ambitious people by moving beyond traditional assumptions of what it means to work in talent acquisition.

Cielo is the world's leading Talent Acquisition Partner. We deliver a better talent experience for everyone through Talent Acquisition, Search, Consulting, and Digital Accelerators™. With our fresh approach – we design and build comprehensive, proven solutions inspired by technology to find and keep the unique talent that elevates our clients above the competition.

FRESH. FORWARD. FLOWERS.

Flowers Foods, Inc. (NYSE:FLO) is not just about baking; it's about crafting moments of joy with every delicious bite. With 2024 sales of $5.1 billion, and as one of the leading producers of packaged bakery goods in the United States, Flowers Foods brings passion to the table. From the wholesome goodness of Nature's Own and Wonder to the bold and artisanal flavors of Dave's Killer Bread, the rustic goodness of Canyon Bakehouse, and the sweet delights of Tastykake, each product is a celebration of taste and quality. Beyond the oven, Flowers Foods fosters a culture that values and reflects Honesty & Integrity, Respect & Inclusion, Sustainability, Passion, and Humility. With a commitment to innovation and a recipe for success, Flowers Foods is more than a bakery – it's a delightful journey into the heart of flavor and community.

Full-time employees are offered the following benefits:

  • Comprehensive health and medical benefits
  • 401(k) Retirement savings plan
  • Professional growth and leadership training
  • Paid vacation, holidays, and parental leave

Benefits may vary depending on your work location.

Bringing Home the Dough

The ideal candidate will have extensive retail account management experience and the skillset to build relationships, conduct business, and enhance Flowers’ reputation with our customers and key decision makers. The Regional Account Manager is responsible for building and implementing the retail customer strategy to attain volume growth targets, achieve sales goals, build market share, expand distribution, manage Accrual Budgets, and increase profitability through more effective assortment, expand authorizations, with effective strategy and tactics regionally.

• Leads, coaches, and supports the retail team.
• Builds and develops a high-performing sales leadership team at the regional level and builds regional culture to ensure high performance results

• Performs other duties which are deemed to be an integral part of the position, including but not limited to fulfillment of work schedules, adherence to attendance policies, and other applicable operating rules, policies, and procedures

Knead to Know: Preferred Qualifications

• Possesses a minimum of 4 years’ experience working in Retail Account Management and CPG sales
• Past success in teamwork and guiding sales

• Master's degree preferred

We offer a competitive salary up to $105k and an excellent total rewards package. Interested job seekers who successfully complete the series of pre-screening questions and who appear to possess the basic qualifications for this position may be contacted for a telephone interview.

Overview

The Department of Agriculture, Fisheries and Forestry (DAFF) has a requirement for a highly skilled ICT Technical Specialist to oversee the delivery of the departments End to End Monitoring Project within the Digital Services Division (DSD). This engagement will not be a full-time role, with DAFF looking to engage a resource on a part-time basis to oversee the programs technical delivery at approximately 1-2 days per week.

DSD is responsible for the management and delivery of Information and Communications Technology (ICT) functions and activities across Australia and overseas for the department. The division provides a secure, modern ICT environment so that the department can conduct its business 24/7 and focus on achieving departmental outcomes.

The End to End Monitoring Project exists to deliver an enterprise monitoring capability that provides monitoring of export systems and services so that potential system issues can be identified and resolved earlier, reducing service disruption for exporters.

The duties performed will include:

  • Working with product development teams to understand system architectures, and services including complex integrations with other systems.
  • Identify gaps in monitoring and logging that need to be addressed, including by both the end-to-end monitoring team and by product development teams.
  • Communicate with business, product development teams and technical stakeholders within DSD about their pain points, potential solutions, their role in monitoring and any blockers as they arise during implementation.
  • Work closely with technical leads to design monitoring dashboards that provide real-time insights into system and application health.
  • Assist the Solution Architect to develop and document strategies for the enterprise monitoring capability.
  • Lead technical planning and delivery of the log aggregator in accordance with the program outcomes, including managing technical dependencies.
  • Lead technical resources on the program to deliver to program outcomes.
  • Maintaining currency and subject matter expertise through ongoing professional development and learning opportunities outside the formal education process.

When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

Parexel is in the business of improving the world’s health. We do this by providing a suite of biopharmaceutical services that help clients across the globe transform scientific discoveries into new treatments. We believe in our values, Patients First, Quality, Respect, Empowerment & Accountability.

This role will work within our innovative Data & Technology group that continues to evolve to meet business needs, fuel Parexel's growth and enable improved support for stakeholders, including customers and ultimately patients, who will benefit from Parexel's integrated processes and systems.

This role can be based in the UK, Serbia, Romania or Poland and can be fully home based in any of those countries.

As the Senior Business Analyst you will work as part of our IT Business Engagement & Enablement department and partner closely with business and technical stakeholders to uncover the true needs of the organization and translate them into clear, actionable, and testable requirements. This role ensures solutions are designed with the end user in mind while meeting enterprise, quality, and regulatory expectations.

In this role you will:

Elicit and define business requirements

  • Identify true business needs using a consulting mindset, distinguishing between “need” and “want.”

  • Gather, analyze, and refine business and functional requirements through stakeholder interviews, workshops, and documentation reviews.

  • Produce clear, complete, and unambiguous requirements documentation, including functional requirements, user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria.

Maintain traceability and support test coverage

  • Own and maintain requirements traceability matrices (RTMs) to ensure all requirements are fully tested.

  • Partner with QA, Technology Quality Management, and delivery teams to validate requirements, acceptance criteria, and test scenarios.

  • Support the definition of User Acceptance Test (UAT) criteria and scenarios and participate in UAT preparation, dry runs, and execution as needed.

Facilitate workshops and stakeholder alignment

  • Facilitate and co-chair workshops, interviews, and working sessions with cross-functional SMEs and stakeholders.

  • Drive collaborative agreement, prioritization, and decision-making across business and technology teams.

  • Communicate effectively with senior stakeholders, sponsors, and functional leaders to align on scope and outcomes.

Translate business needs to technology delivery

  • Act as the primary translator between business stakeholders and engineering teams, ensuring shared understanding of requirements and solution intent.

  • Serve as the voice of the customer within Scrum or delivery teams when a business SME is not embedded.

  • Assist in identifying technical capabilities and solution approaches that align with desired business outcomes.

  • Partner with UX and Human Factors Engineering (HFE) specialists to ensure requirements support intuitive, user-centered solution design.

Enable continuous improvement ​

  • Apply Business Analysis best practices to continuously improve processes, standards, templates, and ways of working.

  • Identify opportunities to streamline workflows and improve efficiency while maintaining quality and compliance.

  • Contribute to the maturity of Business Analysis practices across initiatives and programs.

You will require the following skills:

  • Strong consulting skills, including root cause analysis and the ability to distinguish between true needs and stated wants.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate complex discussions into structured documentation.

  • Proven ability to negotiate, influence, and build consensus with senior stakeholders.

  • Strong requirements documentation and analytical skills.

  • Ability to learn new domains quickly and share knowledge effectively across teams.

  • Ability to work effectively in fast-paced, cross-functional, and globally distributed environments.

  • Comfortable balancing multiple initiatives and priorities simultaneously.

  • Experience with generative AI is preferential, including; requirements drafting and refinement, process analysis and optimisation, workshop acceleration, test case support and backlog grooming assistance.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, computer science, or relevant discipline required.

  • MSc/MBA/advanced degree preferred.

Knowledge and Experience:

  • Advanced level Senior Business Analyst IT experience working in a technical environment within a regulated industry is essential.

  • A strong understanding of clinical trials and previous CRO, Pharma or Biotech industry domain experience is desirable.

  • A solid grounding in Business Analysis best practices and consulting behaviors.

  • Familiarity with Computer System Validation (CSV), SDLC methodologies, and 21 CFR Part 11 concepts.

  • Experience working within regulated environments such as pharmaceutical, biotech, or CRO organizations.

  • Experience supporting project delivery within established Project Lifecycle (PLC) frameworks.

In return we will be able to offer you a structured career pathway and encouragement to develop within the role including awareness and understanding of the industry. You will be well supported and in return for your hard work you will be rewarded with a competitive base salary, holiday as well as other leading benefits you would expect with a top company in the CRO Industry.

Apply today to begin your Parexel journey!

﻿

Our client is seeking an ambitious Sales Manager to accelerate client acquisition, grow settlement volumes, and strengthen corridor activity within their Digital Assets business line. This role is hands-on and results-driven - ideal for someone with a strong network across PSPs, OTC traders, crypto exchanges, or financial institutions who can drive business volume directly into our clients network. Benefits

  • Opportunity to work at the forefront of fintech innovation in cross-border digital asset settlement.
  • Collaborative, high-performance culture with regional career growth opportunities.
