Job Seniority Level:

AI Scientist – Generative AI & Machine Learning

R&D Solutions | IQVIA

Are you looking to work at the forefront of Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence?
Would you be excited to apply cutting‑edge Generative AI technologies to solve complex, real‑world problems with meaningful impact in life sciences and healthcare?

The AI Scientist Group within R&D Solutions (R&DS) at IQVIA is a strategic, customer‑facing team helping pharmaceutical and life sciences organizations design, build, and scale advanced AI/ML solutions. Our team of AI scientists, consultants, and engineers works closely with customers to unlock transformational business value through applied AI innovation.

About the Role

As an AI Scientist, you will work hands‑on with Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and agent‑based systems to design and deliver bespoke AI solutions for pharmaceutical and life sciences customers. You will collaborate with cross‑functional teams and clients to take ideas from use‑case discovery and proof‑of‑concept through scalable production deployment.

This role combines deep technical expertise, innovative problem solving, and consultative delivery in a highly collaborative environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Fine‑tune and distill Large Language Models (LLMs) for a variety of customer use cases.
  • Transform raw structured and unstructured data into high‑quality, trainable datasets for LLM fine‑tuning and distillation.
  • Design and implement AI agents within IQVIA’s Agentic AI framework.
  • Build proof‑of‑concepts (PoCs) that demonstrate the potential and value of Generative AI solutions.
  • Stay current with the latest advancements in Generative AI and Machine Learning, and apply them to real‑world business challenges.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to team members.
  • Present and clearly explain AI solutions to non‑technical stakeholders in customer‑facing engagements.
  • Apply consulting principles to deliver tailored AI solutions aligned with customer needs.
  • Collaborate with internal teams and directly with pharmaceutical and life sciences clients to address business challenges using Generative AI.
  • Partner with multidisciplinary teams to build, deploy, and scale AI/ML solutions in production environments.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • PhD in Computer Science or a closely related field.
  • Proven experience fine‑tuning and/or distilling Large Language Models.
  • Deep understanding and hands‑on experience with:
    • Supervised Fine‑Tuning (SFT)
    • Direct Preference Optimization (DPO)
    • Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO)
    • Reward modeling
  • Publications in top‑tier AI conferences are a strong plus.
  • Strong programming skills in Python.
  • Hands‑on experience with the LangChain / LangGraph ecosystem.
  • Experience deploying machine learning models at scale on cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, Databricks), including Azure OpenAI Services.
  • Excellent analytical and problem‑solving skills with the ability to think creatively and critically.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non‑technical audiences.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast‑paced, client‑focused environment.
  • A strong desire to work in a collaborative, team‑oriented culture.

Why IQVIA

At IQVIA, you’ll have the opportunity to apply advanced AI technologies to some of the most impactful challenges in global healthcare and life sciences—working with world‑class talent, industry‑leading data, and innovative platforms to drive real outcomes.

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at https://jobs.iqvia.com

IQVIA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other status protected by applicable law. https://jobs.iqvia.com/eoe

raw.description:
About Bizee

Bizee has helped nearly two million entrepreneurs start and run their businesses. Now we are building what comes next: an AI-powered Entrepreneur Operating System that helps founders launch, operate, stay compliant, and grow with less friction and more confidence.

We are profitable, founder-led, and operating at a clear inflection point. The next chapter requires a stronger operating system for how we hire, lead, communicate, develop talent, and scale execution across the company.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Head of People & Organizational Effectiveness to serve as a strategic partner to the President and executive team.

This is not a maintenance HR role. It is a builder-operator role for someone who can create clarity, raise the talent bar, strengthen the leadership layer, and build the people systems that help Bizee scale without unnecessary complexity or organizational drag.

As Bizee grows and transforms, one of the most important responsibilities of this role will be building and protecting a high talent bar. We are not simply adding headcount; we are intentionally increasing talent density across the company. This leader will help ensure we hire high-caliber builders, operators, and leaders who raise the standard, strengthen execution, and fit the culture we are building.

You will help design how Bizee hires, onboards, develops, manages, communicates, and performs as we move into our next stage of growth.

What You Will Own

  • Partner with the President and executive team on org design, leadership effectiveness, talent quality, succession, performance, and cross-functional friction.
  • Design and protect Bizee’s talent bar. Build the hiring standards, role scorecards, interview calibration, decision rules, and leadership alignment required to consistently identify high-caliber talent as the company scales. Ensure we do not compromise on quality-of-hire in the name of speed.
  • Design a scalable hiring system, including workforce planning, role definition, scorecards, interview loops, calibration, decision frameworks, and candidate experience.
  • Build Bizee’s People Operating System, including the rhythms, mechanisms, and rituals that drive alignment, accountability, and performance.
  • Strengthen the manager layer through practical enablement, feedback systems, performance routines, and leadership expectations.
  • Design and own Bizee's performance cycle: goal setting, ratings, calibration, and linkage to comp and promotion decisions.
  • Advise on role clarity, leveling, compensation philosophy, incentive design, spans, layers, and capability planning.
  • Build onboarding, engagement, and internal communication mechanisms that help employees ramp faster and stay connected to the mission.
  • Lead change management as Bizee modernizes its platform, operating model, AI-enabled workflows, and distributed teams.
  • Plan and execute the eventual transition away from full co-employment (PEO) arrangements in multiple countries globally, including building the internal HRIS, payroll, benefits and compliance infrastructure needed to stand up direct employment, sequencing the migration to minimize risk and disruption, and managing the associated legal, tax, and employee communication considerations.
  • Own multi-state wage and hour compliance and workforce administration for a distributed employee population spanning nearly all 50 U.S. states, encompassing both exempt and non-exempt staff.
  • Lead and integrate teams across multiple countries internationally, ensuring a single coherent Bizee culture and set of operating standards translate effectively across geographies, management structures, and local labor norms.

Requirements

What You Will Bring

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in People, Talent, HRBP, Organizational Effectiveness, or People Operations leadership.
  • Experience building People systems from the ground up, ideally in a high-growth, profitable, founder-led, PE-backed, SaaS, platform, marketplace, or tech-enabled services environment.
  • Strong executive judgment and the ability to operate as a true strategic partner to a President and executive team.
  • Proven experience with hiring systems, talent calibration, performance management, manager enablement, org design, leveling, compensation frameworks, and People Ops infrastructure.
  • A strong point of view on talent density, quality-of-hire, leadership standards, and what it takes to build a high-performance company.
  • Strong operator instincts: structured, practical, clear, and biased toward action.
  • High EQ and high backbone: able to coach leaders, challenge assumptions, handle sensitive issues, and create clarity without adding drama or bureaucracy.
  • Strategic and hands-on: able to advise the executive team in the morning and fix an onboarding workflow in the afternoon.
  • Business-first orientation: understands revenue, margin, productivity, execution, and the tradeoffs of scaling a profitable company.
  • Low-drama, high-signal communication style: brings facts, judgment, candor, and calm to complex situations.
  • Culture carrier: protects what makes Bizee special while raising the performance bar.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and building while the business is moving fast.
  • Strong written communication skills and the ability to turn messy organizational issues into simple plans and operating mechanisms.
  • Demonstrated experience managing a multi-state U.S. workforce (ideally 40+ states) that includes both exempt and non-exempt employees, with working knowledge of state-by-state wage and hour variation and how to operationalize compliance without adding unnecessary drag.
  • Experience leading or partnering with teams in multiple countries, with a track record of integrating culture, standards, and management practices across borders rather than running parallel, disconnected functions.
  • Direct experience transitioning a workforce out of a co-employment/PEO model, including standing up in-country or in-state direct employment infrastructure (payroll, benefits, statutory compliance) and managing the change process for affected employees and managers.

What Success Looks Like

  • In the first year, Bizee has a stronger People Operating System that improves alignment, ownership, speed, and accountability across the company.
  • Hiring is more structured, faster, and higher-signal. Leaders know what great looks like by role and level, hiring decisions are more disciplined, and the company is increasing talent density as it scales.
  • Managers are better equipped to set direction, coach performance, handle conflict, and create clarity. Employees have stronger expectations, better communication, and a clearer understanding of how their work connects to the company’s mission.

The Head of People & Organizational Effectiveness becomes a trusted advisor to the President, executive team, and leadership layer, helping Bizee scale with discipline, clarity, high standards, and good judgment.

Benefits

The CFO will serve as the primary staff liaison to the Board of Directors’ Finance Committee. The CFO will manage a Finance team of seven.

THIS POSITION IS CONTINGENT UPON FUNDING.

LOCATION AND WORK ENVIRONMENT: The primary location of this position is remote/home based. Job responsibilities may require periodic travel to meetings, conferences, training, and other related activities, and may require a staff member to be in various public places, (e.g., hotel conference rooms). Employees may opt for a hybrid arrangement if they are within commuting distance to our Hallowell, ME office.

PAY GRADE:Grade 10; salary will vary by geographical location.

Essential Job Functions:

  • Financial Planning & Analysis: Set the long-term financial direction for the organization and model the cost of ongoing and future programs and operations, with a particular focus on treasury management. Support decision-making by providing insight into MCD’s financial performance and future outlook.

  • Budgeting and Forecasting: Ensure transparency, accountability, and proper budget management. Lead the annual budgeting process through Board of Directors’ approval. Oversee the twice annual budget reforecasting process.

  • Financial Reporting and Grant Management: Prepare monthly financial statements as well as budget reports for all project and overhead accounts, making sure that funds are spent as per donor intent. Ensure timeliness, accuracy, and usefulness of regular and ad hoc financial information provided to staff members, Board of Directors, funders, and regulatory agencies. Work closely with programs staff to ensure that MCD’s projects achieve >90% of spending to budget/forecast.

  • Compliance and Risk: Ensure that MCD follows U.S. Government/IRS and donor regulations. Manage annual external audit and submission of the Form 990. Periodically review and update financial policy, procedure, and controls to maximize effectiveness and mitigate risk. Work together with the Chief Operating Officer to ensure programs are compliant with national, state, and local regulations in all jurisdictions where MCD Global Health operates, both domestically and internationally.

Requirements

  • A Master’s degree in accounting, finance, business or related discipline

  • Certified Public Accountant (CPA) or Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) certification would constitute an advantage

  • At least 15 years of progressive financial management experience, including executive-level leadership and at least five years supervising staff

  • Experience leading a Finance team at a non-profit or for-profit organization with an annual budget of at least $50 million, preferably in the public health or healthcare sector

  • Experience working with a variety of different funder types, including both public and private

  • Fluency in written and spoken English is required; proficiency in Spanish, French, or Portuguese would constitute an advantage

  • Up to 10% domestic and international travel

  • Individuals who are energetic self-starters, who are able to function comfortably in a team environment and relate well to co-workers and the public, who are comfortable with change and have a positive “can do” attitude, are well suited to this position. This position requires flexibility and the ability to manage time and multiple tasks.

To make this vision real, we’re looking for exceptional, mission-driven people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel.

More than 30,000 companies already rely on Engine to support over 1 million travelers and billions in annual bookings each year. Cash flow positive with rapid growth, we pair exclusive Engine-only rates, industry-leading rewards, and intelligent automation to help businesses save money while delivering world-class personalization and convenience.

Backed by Telescope Partners, Blackstone, and Permira, Engine has been recognized as one of the fastest-growing travel and fintech platforms in North America, with honors including the Deloitte Fast 500 and Built In’s Best Places to Work.

Your Mission

You own GMV for Engine X - our new business credit card that is built on top of Engine's travel platform. That means building the acquisition model from the ground up, identifying the channels and motions that drive real results, and scaling what works. You'll bring a point of view, test it rigorously, and iterate fast.

This is more than a growth role. You'll help shape what we build, how we position it, and where Engine X goes next. You'll have the autonomy to move quickly and the cross-functional support to do it well.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the Strategy. You're the GM for Engine X acquisition. Decide what to test, what to scale, and what to move on from. Translate ambitious targets into concrete plans, channels, and experiments — and back your decisions with data.
  • Build the Acquisition Engine. Stand up the programs, infrastructure, and systems that make Engine X growth predictable and repeatable. Paid, lifecycle, partnerships, sales-assist, content, organic — build the playbook from scratch and grow the team around it as you scale.
  • Ship the Work. Drive large, ambiguous projects forward without losing momentum. Where you have the skills, execute directly. Where you don't, pull in the right people from growth, product, data, or sales. You're a multiplier across the org.
  • Test What's New. Engine X is entering one of the most active fintech markets in years. Bring fresh thinking to how we reach prospects — test messaging, paid programs, partnerships, and GTM motions, and bring back what works.
  • Partner Cross-Functionally. Work directly with Product on roadmap and positioning. Partner with Data to instrument, measure, and learn. Align with Sales on ICP, motion, and handoff. Bring a clear, data-backed perspective to the executive team on where to invest.
  • Lead AI-Native Growth. Engine's growth team uses AI as a core part of how we work. Leverage Claude Code, LLMs, and modern tooling to move faster, build smarter personalization, and run more tests — without depending on engineering or ops.

Qualifications

  • Fintech Experience. You've marketed or sold fintech products — business cards, banking, lending, expense management, or similar. You understand the buyer, the compliance considerations, and what makes fintech GTM distinct from generic B2B SaaS.
  • Owner's Mentality. You operate like a GM. You take ambiguous targets, build the plan, and deliver the outcome.

  • Customer-Centric Thinking. You've built acquisition motions that feel relevant and personal. You start from the customer and work backward.
  • Adaptability. You're comfortable with big markets, fast cycles, and shifting priorities — and you know how to stay focused through it.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct coding experience — apps, websites, or marketing/sales ops infrastructure
  • 0-1 growth experience launching new products
  • Background at a fintech, B2B SaaS, or high-growth marketplace

Tech Stack Claude Code, Snowflake, Amplitude, Attention, Outreach, Customer.io, SQL
